out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: rethermalizer observed with leak under the unit.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please repair leak in rethermalizer.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the WALL TILING at the SERVICE WINDOW is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Please have tiling repaired around the chicken service window.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED AN UNAPPROVED SPLITTER WITH TWO HOSES ATTACHED AT THE MOP SINK.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. CDI: UNAPPROVED SPLITTER REMOVED. IF YOU MUST UTILIZE TWO HOSES, PLEASE PURCHASE THE PRESSURE BLEED DEVICE SHOWN AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
